subject: ui
title: The start screen: projects, the last one first
note: The engine opened with no project shows the projects worked on, the last one first (Enter resumes it), with New project, Open a folder and Forget; an empty list says so. With something in the world that belongs to no project, it says what opening one would leave behind. The engine's own captures never show the screen: a person's project list is served by no tool. New in M5 (the launcher lane).
